title: Dutch Toast with Quick Caramel
description: A twist on the classic Dutch treat, topped with a sweet and gooey caramel sauce.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in the pan.
Add 1 cup of sugar and 1 cup of heavy cream to the pan.
Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring constantly, until the sugar dissolves and the mixture thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in 4 tablespoons of unsalted butter until melted.
Dip each slice of toast into the caramel sauce and top with the sauce.
